provenance.licence: Generated for the game's owner with the owner's Meshy account; Meshy's plan terms apply (not re-verified here). Original, unbranded design: no brand, badge, lettering or plate; the tank's round cap and the tail's plate hugger are painted plain (paintout).
provenance.prompt: Supersport road motorcycle, original design, upright on both wheels. Full fairing enclosing the engine down to a belly pan, sharp nose with two slim angular headlights, small tinted windscreen, clip-on handlebars set low under the windscreen, mirrors mounted on the fairing, long sculpted fuel tank, very slim raised tail cowl with a pointed tail light, rear-set footpegs, short exhaust under the engine, upside-down fork, black three-spoke alloy wheels with wide tyres. Glossy white bodywork with bold red panels. No rider, no side stand, no number plate, no logos, no lettering. Game asset.
provenance.note: The raw Meshy files stay private (assets-src/meshy_output/, git-excluded). A first preview (01a1e27e-4e1f-754c-bb2e-40654fe9642d, a half-faired sport-tourer with raised bars) and a remesh of the refine (01a1e28a-fa99-7236-a34e-325b5b011d24, it lost the windscreen) were not used. Rebuild: node scripts/vehicles/build-sport-moto.mjs
